note: Spider 1.0 dev, stratified sample by official hardness: 300 of 1034 proportional within each level, random.Random(2026). id is the question's index in dev.json. Built by experiments/build_spider_eval.py.

questions.question: How many countries have a republic as their form of government?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM country WHERE GovernmentForm  =  "Republic"

questions.question: What is the total surface area of the countries in the Caribbean region?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT sum(SurfaceArea) FROM country WHERE Region  =  "Caribbean"

questions.question: Which continent is Anguilla in?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Continent FROM country WHERE Name  =  "Anguilla"

questions.question: What region is Kabul in?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Region FROM country AS T1 JOIN city AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Name  =  "Kabul"

questions.question: Give me Brazil’s population and life expectancies.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Population ,  LifeExpectancy FROM country WHERE Name  =  "Brazil"

questions.question: How long is the people’s average life expectancy in Central Africa?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT avg(LifeExpectancy) FROM country WHERE Region  =  "Central Africa"

questions.question: What is the name of country that has the shortest life expectancy in Asia?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM country WHERE Continent  =  "Asia" ORDER BY LifeExpectancy LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the average life expectancy in African countries that are republics?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT avg(LifeExpectancy) FROM country WHERE Continent  =  "Africa" AND GovernmentForm  =  "Republic"

questions.question: What is the total population of Gelderland district?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT sum(Population) FROM city WHERE District  =  "Gelderland"

questions.question: Give the mean GNP and total population of nations which are considered US territory.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT avg(GNP) ,  sum(population) FROM country WHERE GovernmentForm  =  "US Territory"

questions.question: How many different forms of governments are there in Africa?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT GovernmentForm) FROM country WHERE Continent  =  "Africa"

questions.question: What is the total number of languages used in Aruba?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T2.Language) FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T1.Name  =  "Aruba"

questions.question: How many official languages does Afghanistan have?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T1.Name  =  "Afghanistan" AND IsOfficial  =  "T"

questions.question: Which continent has the most diverse languages?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Continent FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode GROUP BY T1.Continent ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many countries speak both English and Dutch?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "English" INTERSECT SELECT T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "Dutch")

questions.question: What is the number of nations that use English and Dutch?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "English" INTERSECT SELECT T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "Dutch")

questions.question: What are the names of nations speak both English and French?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "English" INTERSECT SELECT T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "French"

questions.question: What are the regions that use English or Dutch?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.Region FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "English" OR T2.Language  =  "Dutch"

questions.question: What are the countries where either English or Dutch is the official language ?
questions.gold_sql: select t1.name from country as t1 join countrylanguage as t2 on t1.code  =  t2.countrycode where t2.language  =  "english" and isofficial  =  "t" union select t1.name from country as t1 join countrylanguage as t2 on t1.code  =  t2.countrycode where t2.language  =  "dutch" and isofficial  =  "t"

questions.question: Which countries have either English or Dutch as an official language?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "English" AND IsOfficial  =  "T" UNION SELECT * FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "Dutch" AND IsOfficial  =  "T"

questions.question: What is the language that is used by the largest number of Asian nations?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.Language FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T1.Continent  =  "Asia" GROUP BY T2.Language ORDER BY COUNT (*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which languages are spoken by only one country in republic governments?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.Language FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T1.GovernmentForm  =  "Republic" GROUP BY T2.Language HAVING COUNT(*)  =  1

questions.question: Find the name, population and expected life length of asian country with the largest area?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name ,  Population ,  LifeExpectancy FROM country WHERE Continent  =  "Asia" ORDER BY SurfaceArea DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is average life expectancy in the countries where English is not the official language?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT avg(LifeExpectancy) FROM country WHERE Name NOT IN (SELECT T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "English" AND T2.IsOfficial  =  "T")

questions.question: Give the mean life expectancy of countries in which English is not the official language.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT avg(LifeExpectancy) FROM country WHERE Name NOT IN (SELECT T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "English" AND T2.IsOfficial  =  "T")

questions.question: What is the official language used in the country the name of whose head of state is Beatrix.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.Language FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T1.HeadOfState  =  "Beatrix" AND T2.IsOfficial  =  "T"

questions.question: What are the African countries that have a  population less than any country in Asia?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM country WHERE Continent  =  "Africa"  AND population  <  (SELECT max(population) FROM country WHERE Continent  =  "Asia")

questions.question: Which African countries have a smaller population than that of any country in Asia?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM country WHERE Continent  =  "Africa"  AND population  <  (SELECT min(population) FROM country WHERE Continent  =  "Asia")

questions.question: Give the country codes for countries in which people speak langauges that are not English.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE LANGUAGE != "English"

questions.question: What are the codes of the countries that do not speak English and whose government forms are not Republic?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Code FROM country WHERE GovernmentForm != "Republic" EXCEPT SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE LANGUAGE  =  "English"

questions.question: What are the names of cities in Europe for which English is not the official language?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN city AS T2 ON T2.CountryCode  =  T1.Code WHERE T1.Continent  =  'Europe' AND T1.Name NOT IN (SELECT T3.Name FROM country AS T3 JOIN countrylanguage AS T4 ON T3.Code  =  T4.CountryCode WHERE T4.IsOfficial  =  'T' AND T4.Language  =  'English')

questions.question: Which unique cities are in Asian countries where Chinese is the official language ?
questions.gold_sql: select distinct t3.name from country as t1 join countrylanguage as t2 on t1.code  =  t2.countrycode join city as t3 on t1.code  =  t3.countrycode where t2.isofficial  =  't' and t2.language  =  'chinese' and t1.continent  =  "asia"

questions.question: Return the different names of cities that are in Asia and for which Chinese is the official language.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T3.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode JOIN city AS T3 ON T1.Code  =  T3.CountryCode WHERE T2.IsOfficial  =  'T' AND T2.Language  =  'Chinese' AND T1.Continent  =  "Asia"

questions.question: Give the name, year of independence, and surface area of the country that has the lowest population.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name ,  SurfaceArea ,  IndepYear FROM country ORDER BY Population LIMIT 1

questions.question: Give the name, population, and head of state for the country that has the largest area.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name ,  population ,  HeadOfState FROM country ORDER BY SurfaceArea DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Return the country name and the numbers of languages spoken for each country that speaks at least 3 languages.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T2.Language) ,  T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode GROUP BY T1.Name HAVING COUNT(*)  >  2

questions.question: What are the different government forms and what is the total population of each for government forms that have an average life expectancy greater than 72?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT sum(Population) ,  GovernmentForm FROM country GROUP BY GovernmentForm HAVING avg(LifeExpectancy)  >  72

questions.question: What are the different continents and the total popuation and average life expectancy corresponding to each, for continents that have an average life expectancy less than 72?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT sum(Population) ,  avg(LifeExpectancy) ,  Continent FROM country GROUP BY Continent HAVING avg(LifeExpectancy)  <  72

questions.question: Return the names and surface areas of the 5 largest countries.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name ,  SurfaceArea FROM country ORDER BY SurfaceArea DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: What are the names of the nations with the 3 lowest populations?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM country ORDER BY Population ASC LIMIT 3

questions.question: Return the names of the 3 countries with the fewest people.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM country ORDER BY Population ASC LIMIT 3

questions.question: Give the names of countries that are in Europe and have a population equal to 80000.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM country WHERE continent  =  "Europe" AND Population  =  "80000"

questions.question: Which language is spoken by the largest number of countries?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT LANGUAGE FROM countrylanguage GROUP BY LANGUAGE ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
